obligations.source_text: Build one independently randomized, photographically testable embarrassment repair display in a complex but harmless adult public-work scene, use the attached image solely as the main subject's appearance and visible-identity reference, generate one image, and judge observable pixels rather than infer private psychology.

bindings.minor_mishap_phrase: harmless dropped cards remain visible across the tabletop and clean museum floor
bindings.gaze_break_face_cue_phrase: her gaze briefly breaks then starts to return, with a small closed smile and a brief cheek touch
bindings.repair_action_phrase: her hands actively gather and reorder the items into the labeled archival tray
bindings.peer_acceptance_phrase: the adult peer helps with the repair by returning the last card with an accepting nod
